body: I watch as the soft waves gently wash over the pristine blue shells, each one a silent testimony to the ocean's gentle touch. The sight calms my racing mind, reminding me of nature’s beauty and strength in its simple forms. My protective instinct grows stronger, urging me to stand guard over these new treasures.
